nom: BYOMA Brightening Serum for Dark Spots + Texture

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers are split: some report breakouts and pimples after starting the serum, while others say it hydrates without adding shine or extra oiliness and helps with dry patches.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers generally report strong hydration, softer texture and relief of dry patches, with one exception who broke out despite the moisturizing feel.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe reduced oiliness in the T-zone, smaller pores and a texture that balances oily and dry areas without tightness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report the serum as gentle, non-irritating and fragrance-light, with one recommending it specifically for lighter brightening needs due to its mildness.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (40s) describe reduced pore size, lighter dark spots and improved texture within weeks, without dryness or irritation.
segments.normal: A normal-skin reviewer in her 20s reports an unusual breakout in areas she doesn't typically experience, while other normal-skin users report smoother, brighter skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for fine lines and dullness associated with aging report smoother texture and slightly diminished fine lines over about a month.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers citing dryness or dehydration report strong, fast hydration, plumper skin and resolved dry patches; none report worsened dryness.
concerns.redness: Reviewers do not report redness as an ongoing issue; a few mention no irritation or redness developing during use.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers report visible barrier repair (healthier-looking skin, less sensitivity over time) after weeks of use, with one explicitly crediting it for restoring a compromised barrier.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers focused on dark spots and hyperpigmentation report gradual fading of acne marks, melasma or sun spots within one to several weeks; a few say it is too early to tell or see minimal change.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fewer breakouts or fading acne scars, but multiple others—mostly self-identified as oily or acne-prone—report new breakouts, including one describing six pimples at once and another citing cystic pimples that later faded with continued use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers report the serum does not leave skin oily or greasy and, for some oily or combination skin, reduces excess sebum and congestion.

extraits.titre: A big no no for me.
extraits.texte: Bought it because I wanted to lessen the amount of steps in my skin care routine as it has HA + Niacinamide. Didn't see much results within the first couple weeks, but thought it just needed some time to adapt to my skin. One day i noticed i had a lot of red dots on my face, which later evolved into a full blown break out. 😩 I've had clear skin for my whole life, maybe a pimples here and there… but 6 juicy pimples at once??? I countinued using the serum for a few more days, and more pimples surfaced. Since Byoma was the newest serum to my long time skincare routine, I stopped it. My skin has calmed down since then, but now I'm fighting acne scars. 😭 Im not saying this is a bad product, maybe just not for me or my skin type. For reference, my skin type is oily. (Confirmed my medspa)

I was hesitant to try another niacinamide serum after The Ordinary's 10% serum burned the heck outta my face, but I wanted to reap the benefits of niacinamide so I gave it a shot. Best decision EVER! I have extremely textured skin, and I can never go more than a day without washing my face before it gets so oily and textured and congested and YUCK! But using this paired with Paula's Choice salicylic acid cleanser, WOAH MOMMA my skin texture is GONE! I also had a very compromised skin barrier due to poor skincare practices in the past, and this has helped SO much in healing my skin! I recently attended a 5 day event and only ended up having time to wash my face ONCE in that 5 day period, but I was absolutely amazed that my skin still felt clean and texture-free despite HEAVILY sweating and skipping face wash two days in a row, I've NEVER been able to skip even one day without my skin getting all congested til now! I've noticed a SIGNIFICANT reduction in the amount of oil and sebum my skin produces (combination skin, a lot oilier in the summer!) and the hyralonic acid compliments my lightweight gel-cream moisturizer PERFECTLY! I am so extremely fungal acne prone in addition to having very sensative skin, which made finding a good serum a nightmare, so I'm so happy to have finally found a keeper!

extraits.titre: Great on mature, dry, sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I have been using this product for a little over a month, and I'm impressed. I've used Vit C sera before, but this one has delivered results quickly. My pores appear smaller and lighter, and my dark spots are slightly less visible. Overall, the texture of my skin has improved considerably in a short amount of time. My skin is fairly sensitive and dry, but I have not experienced any drying or irritation from this product.

I'm 47 w/combo dry w/oily t zone. I highly recommend this product for any skin type. It's very gentle and soothing. I use it as one step in my skincare routine- step 4 of 7. I 🤔 I was reordering this, but instead I ordered the Hydrating Serum. We are going on a new adventure!

I had some dry patches on my face that i could not get rid of, no matter how much i exfoliated and moisturized. I stopped using all other products, and only used this serum along with moisturizer for 2 weeks AM and PM. Dry patches gone, my skin is healthy again, barrier restored! Will keep using!

I have heard good things about Byoma, I've seen many videos on social media and reviews praising their skincare line. I'm a 19 year old girl who has always struggled with acne since I started puberty. Recently I started a birth control pill and had some hormonal breakouts (worse than the ones I experienced pre-pill) since I was adjusting to new hormones. This serum INSTANTLY made a difference from the day I started using it. I've noticed a significant decrease in my acne dark spots from scarring and past pimples. This being said, I've also used their Clarifying Serum and Hydrating Serum at the same time. I use all three everyday since the day I got them and they are GREAT. The Clarifying Serum helps with breakouts, the Brightening Serum has really helped lighten some dark spots from old cystic pimples, and the Hydrating Serum balances my skin without leaving any greasy residue. I 100% recommended these products, my skin is usually sensitive to certain ingredients but I have never had a reaction to these products. I don't think I have ever left a review before but these products were so helpful for me that I felt the need to.

I believe byoma brightness serum is a good serum. It's odorless and it's lightweight and gets absorbed into the skin very quickly, however it doesn't work on people with only skin because it break me out a lot so I don't know if it helps brighten the skin when I consistently keep breaking out so maybe it would work better on someone with dry skin.
